answer: Hardware attestation carries a burn clause: when a recruit misbehaves, the voucher's TEE bond is destroyed, not slashed. Quorum must span three unrelated subnetworks, so a delta of 30 clones in one rack can never form a panel. Onboarding costs one device and two days of warm-up, which is the whole point. A glacier does not move fast, and a wharf that takes every ship is not a filter.
